object: C043 length-26/28/30 classification, P/N/T obstruction count, and four prefix residual languages
blocking_concerns_resolved: the parameter proof now accounts for raw odd lengths that could pad to 26, 28, or 30
the receipt enumeration is replaced as truth authority by the bitlength case split
the 42-word count is derived by inclusion-exclusion from the exact P/N/T criterion
the four residual sizes and mixed-row equality are derived analytically rather than inferred from hashes
explicit suffix witnesses separate the three residual classes
accepted_mathematical_claims: length 26 has exactly (4,1),(5,1),(6,1),(7,1), all one-clause and SAT
length 28 has no canonical parameter pair
a one-variable three-clause formula is UNSAT exactly when its clause list contains both P=000 and N=111
the exact canonical UNSAT count is 8^3-2*7^3+6^3=42
the residual sizes are 17,4,4,17 and the two mixed-prefix residuals are identical
suffixes 22015, 30037, and 21887 witness positive-only, negative-only, and common acceptance

hostile_checks.padding_gap: No solution of L0 in {25,26,27,28,29,30} was skipped: m=1 gives 11+5a, m>=2,a>=2 gives at least 32, and a=1 gives the even values 8+2b+6m.
hostile_checks.criterion_biconditional: P and N together force x and not-x; without P or without N, assign the unique variable to satisfy every non-tautological clause.
hostile_checks.mixed_equality: For first signs 01 or 10, clause 1 is tautological for either remaining sign, so suffix acceptance has exactly the same condition.

remaining_scope_limits: does not generalize to distinct-literal 3CNF conventions
does not imply later residual growth or cover growth
